name: Stalimur
description: Stalimur was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Hegemony sector. The stormy world featured moors inhabited by a population of farmers known as the Stalimurans, who observed a Tionese winter holiday known as the Devouring. The world was also home to the vicious Stalimur pirates.
